summary: Zoomcar Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K/A to correct prior disclosure of its Series A unit private placement second closing. The amendment adjusts the number of units issued from 662 to 537, clarifies each warrant is exercisable for 20,000 shares (aggregate 10,740,000 shares of common stock), and extends the offering termination date to July 30, 2026. Units sold at $1,000 each for ~$537,000 gross proceeds. This is a routine capital-raise disclosure correction, not a special situation.
